Assessment.disclaimer: This is a quick self-assessment, not an audit, certification or legal opinion. The questions are original and inspired by: {frameworks}. Thresholds are refined over time with real answers.

AiPath.title: AI transformation starts with service and dealer support
AiPath.subtitle: It's where results show fastest and the data (manuals, service bulletins, past tickets) is already in your hands. With the trust we earn there, we move on to production, quality and sales.
AiPath.pain1: Do your dealers and customers keep asking the same fault and how-to questions, tying your engineers up on the phone?
AiPath.pain2: Are manuals, service bulletins and price lists lost in folders, with only a few people knowing the right answer?
AiPath.pain3: Do new dealers and technicians ask headquarters about everything, with someone writing the same answer from scratch each time?
AiPath.step1Text: A short assessment call, then a report in 5 business days ranking the processes with the highest return.
AiPath.step2Title: 2. Technical service & help desk assistant pilot
AiPath.step2Text: An assistant that answers questions from dealers, technicians and users from your own manuals; live on one channel in 3 weeks without changing your existing software.
AiPath.step3Text: Once the pilot works, a production rollout; then the same approach in quality, production, sales and procurement.
AiPath.proof: In different projects, AI-assisted systems cut support ticket resolution time by 40–70%.

Expertise.title: Systems that work in the field, not theory
Expertise.body: With 13+ years in systems architecture, backend platforms, IoT and cloud infrastructure, I turn manufacturers' scattered documentation and service knowledge into stable AI systems. Instead of theoretical advice, I build end-to-end solutions that speed up technical requests from the field, without replacing your ERP or service software.
Expertise.focus1: Technical support assistant for dealers and authorised service partners
Expertise.focus2: Knowledge base built from manuals, service bulletins and fault records
Expertise.focus3: Connecting ERP, IoT and service data to that assistant
